title: A Scorpio Already Knows
topic: Scorpio zodiac satire: a Scorpio already knows
mechanism: Inside a Scorpio head there is a dark room: a corkboard of SUSPECT photos tied with red string, a filing cabinet marked EVIDENCE, a SECRETS padlock with no key, and a DAYS SINCE I FORGAVE counter stuck at 0.

beats.hook: Girls' night at the bar under a SCORPIO sign: Vera stares at Jen's new boyfriend Tom without blinking
beats.story: Vera knows your password; her phone finds Tom's ex in 8 minutes; Jen tells her to stop; Vera writes in her notebook
beats.rise: Jen ignores her: flowers, dinners, weekend trips, matching sweaters
beats.twist: The doorbell rings: Kim, his other girlfriend, in the same sweater; Tom flees into the closet; Vera is already pouring three glasses
beats.mechanism: Dark room in her head: corkboard SUSPECT photos with red string, filing cabinet EVIDENCE, padlock SECRETS with no key, counter DAYS SINCE I FORGAVE at 0
beats.ending: Jen and Kim become best friends at the wine table; Vera pins a new photo: YOUR NEW COWORKER

seed.what: Vera's notebook on the bar, open on a page headed TOM, with a sketch of a second girl
